acceptance/2026-fall.html:
You've been accepted to TAMU Datathon 26! See you November 7–8 at the MSC Bethancourt Ballroom. ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏

Congratulations!

Howdy! We're excited to let you know that you've been accepted to TAMU Datathon 26! Your application truly impressed us, and we can't wait to see what you build.

{{#invitationRequired}}

You Aren't Done Yet!

Due to capacity constraints, we need you to confirm your spot by accepting the invitation on your applicant dashboard. Spots are limited! If you don't confirm your spot before the event date or before we reach capacity, you'll be moved to the waitlist.

 
{{/invitationRequired}} {{^invitationRequired}}

There's nothing else you need to do to confirm your spot. Just show up, and we'll see you there!

{{/invitationRequired}}

Event Details

Date: Saturday & Sunday, November 7–8, 2026

Check-in: Starts at 9:00 AM on Saturday, with kickoff at 10:00 AM

Location: MSC 2300 Bethancourt Ballroom, Texas A&M University

What's Next?

Your check-in QR code will appear on your applicant dashboard. Have it ready when you arrive, since we'll use it for check-in and meals.

Keep an eye on our Discord and Instagram for updates leading up to the event, and check out our FAQ for answers to common questions.

We can't wait to see you at TAMU Datathon 26!

Questions? Contact us at connect@tamudatathon.com.

acceptance/2026-spring.subject: [ACTION NEEDED] Congratulations on being accepted to TAMU Datathon Spring 2026!
acceptance/2026-spring.html:
TAMU DATATHON

Howdy!

Congratulations! We’re excited to inform you that you’ve been ACCEPTED to the TAMU Datathon-Lite Spring 2026! Your application truly impressed us, and we can't wait to see you at the Peterson Building on April 11th 2026.

You aren't done YET!

Due to capacity constraints we need you to confirm your spot by accepting the invitation at https://tamudatathon.com/apply. Spots are limited! If you fail to confirm your spot before the event date or before we reach capacity, you will be put on the WAITLIST.

What's Next?

We will provide a QR code, which will appear in your applicant dashboard and be used for check-in, as well as lunch. Be sure to keep an eye on our Discord and Instagram for updates.

If you have any questions, please refer to our FAQ or contact us at connect@tamudatathon.com.

TD Website

travel-reimbursement/2026-fall.subject: Travel Reimbursements for TAMU Datathon 26
travel-reimbursement/2026-fall.html:
Travel reimbursements are available for TAMU Datathon 26. Deadline: Friday, Oct 16. ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏

Howdy!

Interested in participating in TAMU Datathon 26, but don't live near Texas A&M? We've got you covered!

This year, TAMU Datathon is offering travel reimbursements to help students from other universities attend and participate in our event!

We want to make TAMU Datathon more accessible to students from all schools, regardless of distance, and we hope this opportunity makes it easier for you to join us!

Deadline: Friday, October 16

The deadline for travel reimbursement is Friday, October 16 (Central Time). Learn more about travel reimbursements and eligibility here.

We hope to see you at TAMU Datathon 26!

Questions? Contact us at connect@tamudatathon.com.

See Eligibility & Details

waitlist/2026-fall.subject: You're on the waitlist for TAMU Datathon {{eventSeason}} {{eventYear}}
waitlist/2026-fall.html:
You're on the TAMU Datathon 26 waitlist, and you can still come on Saturday, November 7. ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏

You're on the Waitlist

Howdy! Thank you for applying to TAMU Datathon 26! We received a lot of interest this year, and due to limited capacity, you've been placed on our waitlist.

The good news: you can still try to join us in person!

You Can Still Come!

Waitlisted participants are welcome to come to the MSC 2300 Bethancourt Ballroom on Saturday, November 7. Check-in starts at 9:00 AM.

Once accepted participants have checked in, we'll admit people from the waitlist as space allows. We can't guarantee a spot, but we'd love to have you if there's room!

In the meantime, keep an eye on our Discord and Instagram for updates, and check out our FAQ for answers to common questions.

We hope to see you at TAMU Datathon 26!

Questions? Contact us at connect@tamudatathon.com.

TD Website

workshop/2026-fall-scikit-learn.subject: [Food Provided!] Join Us for ML Basics with scikit-learn
workshop/2026-fall-scikit-learn.html:
ML Basics with scikit-learn: Wednesday, Oct 28, 7–8 PM in Peterson 119. Food provided! ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏

Howdy!

TAMU Datathon is hosting a workshop on Machine Learning Basics with scikit-learn, and we'd love for you to join us!

We'll walk through the fundamentals of machine learning using scikit-learn, one of the most popular ML libraries in Python. Whether you're brand new to machine learning or looking for a refresher, this workshop is a great place to start.

It's also a great way to get ready for TAMU Datathon 26 on November 7–8!

Workshop Details

When: Wednesday, October 28, 7:00–8:00 PM

Where: Peterson 119

Food: Provided! Come hungry.

We hope to see you there!
